context:
Goal: q_max PRs #1163 and #1161 merge, and their debts close for the right reason.
Problem (goal): the merge tool refuses both debt closes because their retire tests could not run in its scratch copy, and the pick showed you only two of four routes.
Based on (ruling): decision debt-close-runs-retire already gives a way out when the check cannot run: a `Retire-run: <slug> -- <run URL>` line in the PR body that names a green CI run on the PR head; this is a re-ask because you asked for every route.
Based on (read): CI was green on both PRs; the claude-settings lane that fixes the scratch-copy run is already working.
Departs from: main refuses both closes until a check runs or the PR names a green run — the pick took neither route.

options.gain: The debt closes for the right reason, and later debt closes do not hit the same refusal.
options.how: The merge tool refused q_max PR #1163's debt close because its retire test ran in a scratch copy with no installed packages, though CI was green and 34 tests pass locally. A claude-settings lane fixes that test run (lint/check_debt_retire.py), then batch runner 11 runs the merge again.
options.label: Keep the pick
options.lose: Both PRs wait until the test-run fix lands and runner 11 merges again.

options.how: The q_max lane drops the debt close from PR #1163 and the PR merges without it.
options.label: Drop the debt close
options.lose: The debt stays open, and the next debt close hits the same refusal.

options.gain: Both PRs merge now through the route the debt-close record already gives, and each debt closes on a real green run.
options.how: The q_max lane adds a Retire-run line to each PR body, naming its green CI run, and runner 11 merges again; the fix lane keeps going for later debt closes. Undo: remove the line.
options.label: Name the green run (Recommended)
options.lose: The two debts close on CI's run, not the merge tool's own; the fix still has to land for the next close.

options.gain: The PRs stop waiting, and the debts still close for the right reason.
options.how: PRs #1163 and #1161 merge now without their debt closes. The fix lane keeps going, and a small follow-up PR closes each debt once the fix lands. Undo: put the debt close back in the PR.
options.label: Merge now, close the debt after
options.lose: Two small follow-up PRs; the debts stay open until they merge.

ref: coordinator pick, Nov 12, 12:51 CST (its clock); options c and d added after your 15:26 CST note
short: Fix debt-close test run for q_max #1163
title: Fix the debt-close test run so q_max #1163 can close its debt
why: A coordinator pick you could not see before.
